# function: apigateway_route_response

Builds the ARN of an `apigateway` `RouteResponse`:

```
arn:${Partition}:apigateway:${Region}::/apis/${ApiId}/routes/${RouteId}/routeresponses/${RouteResponseId}
```

`${Partition}`, `${Region}` and `${Account}` come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
apigateway_route_response(api_id string, route_id string, route_response_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `api_id` (String) Value for `${ApiId}` in the ARN template.
1. `route_id` (String) Value for `${RouteId}` in the ARN template.
1. `route_response_id` (String) Value for `${RouteResponseId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given.
